en: \[VSCode] Fixed Ctrl+J in the chat input always inserting a newline: it is now left to VS Code and the OS when "ctrl+j" is set to null in the Chat context of \~/.claude/keybindings.json
zh: \[VSCode] 修复了聊天输入框中 Ctrl+J 总是插入换行的问题：当在 `~/.claude/keybindings.json` 的 Chat 上下文中将“ctrl+j”设为 null 时，现在交由 VS Code 和操作系统处理
